entities.name: Bengal Famine of 1943
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: A devastating famine in British-ruled Bengal (1943) that killed an estimated 2–3 million people. Caused by a convergence of cyclone damage, wartime diversion of food supplies, and British policy failures under Churchill's government. The famine radicalized Indian opinion against colonial rule and remains one of the most studied man-made famines in history.
